create_robot_wrist_ft_sensor: create a RobotWristFTSensor instance with a wrist force torque sensor object and a name string
get_observables_dict: get the observables dictionary mapping force and torque observation keys to Generic observable objects
get_obs_key_for_force: get the observation key string for the FORCE observation type using get_obs_key method
read_wrist_force_data: read the wrist force sensor data as a numpy array from the MuJoCo physics state
read_wrist_torque_data: read the wrist torque sensor data as a numpy array from the MuJoCo physics state
